etymologies.etymologyHTML: From head +‎ phone.

definitions.definition: A cushioned speaker placed on, over, or inside the ear, normally used in left/right pairs.

quote.citation: 2017, Mark J. Butler, Electronica, Dance and Club Music:
quote.text: From "Little" Louie Vega, David Camacho, and Tyrone Francis I learned about seamless beatmixing, using a so-called lollipop headphone for one ear and a monitor speaker for the other.
